name: eva
description: eva is an open-source evaluation framework for computational pathology foundation models, designed to benchmark models across diverse downstream classification tasks with modular and adaptable datasets, metrics, and protocols. It establishes the first public reproducible pathology FM leaderboard and promotes standardized evaluation practices.
reputation: Widely used in computational pathology as a public, reproducible benchmark and leaderboard for evaluating foundation models across downstream tasks.
notes: Framework supports off-the-shelf and customized datasets and architectures for pathology foundation models.
